Backup / Export

Backup: complete data JSON file mein export karo. New device/browser par Import karke data restore kar sakte ho.

Important: backup ko phone/laptop ke bahar Google Drive/USB/email par bhi save karo. Browser local storage ko single source of truth mat samjho.
